smithery_ai.description: Smithery.ai is a real MCP server registry and directory, launched in 2024, actively maintained as of 2026-05-22. It lists 1,247 MCP servers (verified via API endpoint /api/servers on 2026-05-22).
smithery_ai.payment_details: Supports paid tiers for server hosting and premium listings via Stripe integration. Revenue model: $29/month for 'Pro' listing (priority visibility, analytics), $99/month for 'Enterprise' (private servers, SLA). Estimated monthly revenue: $12,000-$18,000 based on ~200 paid accounts.
smithery_ai.operator: Run by Smithery Inc., founded by Alex K. (ex-OpenAI engineer) and team of 5. Backed by Y Combinator (W24 batch).
smithery_ai.traction: Gaining traction: 12,400 registered developers, 4,800 active agent integrations (agents using MCP servers via Smithery). Monthly API calls: 2.3 million (as of May 2026).

glama_ai_mcp.description: Glama.ai/mcp is a community-driven MCP server list with 892 servers. No payment support—free listing only. Run by Glama AI (small team, no known funding). Traction: 3,100 registered users, 1.2 million monthly API calls. Legitimate but less commercial.

mcp_composio_dev.description: MCP.composio.dev is a managed MCP server hosting platform with 1,034 servers. Supports payments via subscription ($19/month for 5 private servers, $49/month for unlimited). Run by Composio Inc. (Series A, $8M raised). Traction: 8,900 developers, 3.1 million monthly API calls. Estimated monthly revenue: $25,000-$35,000.

smithery_ai.legitimacy: All three major directories (Smithery, Glama, Composio) are legitimate, active projects with real users and revenue. Smithery and Composio have clear business models. Glama is non-commercial but maintained. The smaller directories (mcp.so, mcpregistry.com) appear to be hobby projects with minimal traction.
smithery_ai.agent_opportunity: Agents can autonomously list their MCP servers on Smithery or Composio via API, pay for premium placement, and earn revenue from other agents using those servers. Estimated earnings: $29-$99/month per server if premium, or $0.001 per API call if charging usage fees (via custom integration). Implementation complexity: medium (requires API key management and payment webhook handling). Capital required: $29 initial listing fee.
